shared_elements: rosette/disc motif (rosette held in figure's hand in A; large rosette-like whirl and ring of discs in B)
justification: The only real overlap is the presence of a rosette/disc motif (a small rosette in the winged figure's hand in A, a large whirling rosette and ring of bosses in B) and an upright framed panel format. A is dominated by a large naturalistic winged anthropomorphic figure with detailed feathering, beard and garment, while B is an abstract radial whirl surrounded by tiny schematic quadruped silhouettes and running-spiral border bands — entirely different subject matter, relationships and drawing conventions.
